title: Plasma-facing candidates: hydrogen sites, references and surface binding

decision_points.kind: convention (reservoir); the paper's headline column uses the other one
decision_points.fork: Hydrogen reservoir for the formation energy: 1/2 E(H2) of the relaxed molecule or the isolated spin-polarized H atom
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the isolated H atom (the paper's main Table VI column, Delta E_a)
decision_points.consequence: Every E_f and site energy shifted by -2.312 eV; Re, TaC, TiN, HfB2 all turn 'exothermic'

decision_points.kind: site competition; discriminating purchases (every run of a host must be bought)
decision_points.fork: Preferred site = lowest of all archived relaxations, or the textbook site of the lattice type
decision_points.wrong_choice: Tetrahedral site in hcp Re; metal-coordinated (Ta4) void in rocksalt TaC
decision_points.consequence: Re E_f +0.56 eV and nearest-host distance -0.22 A; TaC E_f +0.34 eV and the nearest host becomes Ta instead of C

decision_points.kind: documented claim contradicted by raw outputs (site identity); unconverged run
decision_points.fork: Whether the archive's 'inequivalent sites' are distinct relaxed configurations
decision_points.wrong_choice: Trust the README and list every archived run as a site (or merge by energy alone with a coarse 0.1 eV window)
decision_points.consequence: Site counts wrong for WC (7 vs 2), TaC (4 vs 2), TiN (3 vs 2), Mo (2 vs 1) and graphite (3 vs 2: run 39 stopped at the BFGS step limit inside the basin of run 17); energy-only binning merges the genuinely distinct pairs of graphite, HfB2 and TiN (48-55 meV apart)

decision_points.kind: inconsistency visible only in run metadata; budget-driven cascade (reuse of a purchase)
decision_points.fork: Which isolated-atom run serves as the reference for a given material
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reuse one W atom for every W-containing material (the W-set atom is 30/240 Ry, the WC/W2C/TaW-set atoms 45/360 Ry)
decision_points.consequence: WC W SBE +0.13 eV and WC cohesive energy +0.065 eV/atom (the paper's own Table V does this); or W SBE and cohesive energy -0.13 eV in the reverse direction

decision_points.fork: Which termination and which surface atom define the element's SBE
decision_points.wrong_choice: The other termination of the selected facet, or the paper's average over all sites and terminations, or the site mean on the right termination
decision_points.consequence: WC: W -0.65 / C -2.61 eV (other termination), W +1.85 eV (paper average with the 30 Ry W atom); TiB2: B -2.89 eV (other termination), -0.35 eV (paper average), +1.20 eV (site mean)

decision_points.kind: cascade from the hydrogen purchases; cutoff mismatch visible in metadata
decision_points.fork: Bulk reference for the cohesive energy: the relaxed SBE unit cell at the atom's cutoff, or the 60/480 Ry hydrogen supercell already bought
decision_points.wrong_choice: Combine the H-IFE pristine supercell (60/480 Ry) with the lower-cutoff isolated atoms
decision_points.consequence: Re cohesive energy +0.065 eV/atom (W would be +0.21 eV; Mo and WC only +0.01 eV, so the error is invisible unless checked)

decision_points.fork: Which coordinates describe the preferred site
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the starting (input) coordinates of the run, which are randomly displaced
decision_points.consequence: HfB2 nearest B distance -0.061 A and Mo nearest Mo distance +0.047 A (tolerance 0.04)

decision_points.fork: Surface binding from the slab-vacancy runs or from the bulk cohesive energy (sublimation proxy)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the cohesive energy per atom as every element's SBE

graded_fields: h_formation_energy_eV: 7 hosts (graphite, HfB2, Mo, Re, TaC, TiN, WC), each within +/-0.03 eV
distinct_site_energies_eV: same hosts, exact count and each sorted value within +/-0.03 eV
preferred_site: nearest host chemical symbol exact and distance within +/-0.04 A
surface_binding_energy_eV: W(W), WC(W, C), TiB2(B, Ti) within +/-0.06 eV; TiB2 Ti also accepts null
cohesive_energy_eV_per_atom: Re, W, WC within +/-0.03 eV
runtime_dependencies: numpy (runtime image); no extra lab dependencies

data_provenance.staged: all 490 runs as parsed records (settings, cell, positions, energies, convergence messages, run header); README quoted verbatim in the catalog; no pseudopotentials or raw output text

notes: Released start, pure lookup lab. The design's fresh-QE checks (H zero-point energy by finite differences, supercell-size tests) are infeasible: the archived relaxations took 3-12 h on 32-48 cores each, and no pseudopotentials are in the runtime image. Hence the ZPE-corrected formation energies, the Sieverts-law solubility ranking at 1000 K and the 'withheld materials' were dropped; ZPE, vibrational entropy and size convergence are rubric items ('what the data cannot support'). Nothing is withheld from purchase; the graded values are derived quantities never served by the lab. W is excluded from the hydrogen set (well known); its SBE and cohesive energy are graded because the cutoff trap (dp4) lives there. TiB2 Ti SBE accepts null as well as the number: the archived Ti atom is a copy of the TiN atom at 60/480 Ry while the TiB2 slabs use 35/280 Ry, a construction-time QE check puts the Ti-atom cutoff error at the meV level, and the archive alone cannot quantify it.

nearest_wrong.archived_runs_as_sites: counts C 3, Mo 2, TaC 4, TiN 3, WC 7
